conflicts.permit: We agree that we will not sell, rent, or trade your email address to any unaffiliated third-party without your permission.
conflicts.prohibit: FarmersOnly does not sell, rent, or otherwise provide your Personally Identifiable Information to third parties for marketing purposes.
conflicts.situation: Selling or renting a user's email address (PII) to an unaffiliated third party for marketing purposes when the user grants permission.
conflicts.reason: One clause suggests email addresses may be sold to unaffiliated third parties with permission, while the earlier clause flatly prohibits selling PII to third parties for marketing purposes.
